run_config.strategy_description: Donchian channel breakout with volume confirmation and regime gating

used_sizing.active_rule: Use a fixed USDT notional per trade before leverage.

used_costs.unit_convention: Fields ending in _pct are fractional percentages: 0.01 means 1%, 1.0 means 100%. Monetary fields explicitly include _usd or _usdt.

strategy_constraints.description: exit_period must be smaller than channel_period so the exit reacts faster than the entry breakout.
exit_period must be meaningfully faster than channel_period; otherwise the strategy exits too slowly for this Donchian design.

strategy_params.channel_period: Bars used to define the Donchian breakout high/low.

strategy_params.exit_period: Shorter channel period used by the strategy's own signal exit.

strategy_params.vol_mult: Volume surge multiplier used as breakout confirmation.

exit_modes.chandelier: Position-aware volatility trailing exit from the best price reached since entry.

exit_modes.chandelier_ema: Chandelier trail plus EMA recross exit for failed breakouts.

exit_modes.chandelier_time: Chandelier trail plus maximum holding-time stop.

exit_modes.chandelier_full: Chandelier trail plus EMA failed-breakout exit plus maximum holding-time stop.

exit_modes.signal_be_trail: Strategy signal exit plus ATR stop, breakeven trigger, and trailing stop.

exit_modes.signal: Exit only when the strategy emits the opposite or close signal.

exit_modes.trail: ATR trailing stop without Chandelier highest-high/lowest-low tracking.

exit_modes.bracket: Fixed ATR stop-loss and take-profit bracket.

exit_modes.bar_close_sl_tp: Bracket-like SL/TP evaluated on bar close for conservative next-bar execution.

exit_params.trail_atr_period: ATR lookback used to estimate current volatility for stops.

exit_params.trail_atr_mult: ATR multiple used as the trailing-stop distance.

exit_params.sl_atr_mult: Initial hard stop distance measured in ATR.

exit_params.chandelier_lookback: Bars used to track the highest high or lowest low for Chandelier exits.

exit_params.be_trigger_atr: Profit in ATR required before moving the stop to breakeven.

exit_params.tp_atr_mult: Take-profit distance measured in ATR for bracket-style exits.

exit_params.ema_exit_period: EMA period used by Chandelier+EMA modes to detect failed breakouts.

exit_params.time_stop_bars: Maximum bars to keep a position open before forcing an exit.

exit_params.cooldown_bars: Bars to wait after a stop before allowing a fresh entry.

available_params_ref.why_separate: Reusable registry data is split out so repeated AI chats can attach it once and then attach only run-specific context files.

channel_period.recommendation: Best channel_period is at the upper boundary (55); test higher values while watching trade count decay.

grid_sweep.top_results_explanation: Robust-ranked top rows. Rows passing 5/6 gates are preferred; if none pass, best near-misses are shown with explicit gate failures.

candidate_rejection_analysis.interpretation: Counts are approximate hard-gate blockers over the grid rows.
candidate_rejection_analysis.suggestion: Fix the blocker with the largest count before expanding the grid size.

final_strategy_scorecard.interpretation: Final score rewards broad robustness more than peak performance.
final_strategy_scorecard.suggestion: Only DEPLOY_NATIVE candidates should move to native Nautilus validation; REFINE_SWEEP candidates need a narrower robust grid.

surface_analysis.suggestion: Prefer broad plateaus over isolated best points; densify if plateau width is narrow.

regime_aware_plateaus.interpretation: Every grid combo was re-scored separately inside each regime bucket using persisted trades; plateau detection then ran per segment.

trade_diagnostics.interpretation: This is a compact duplicate of trade diagnostics for the same top combos, grouped under a global trade_diagnostics key for readers who want trade behavior without scanning grid_sweep.top_results.
trade_diagnostics.suggestion: Use grid_sweep.top_results when you need params plus metrics; use trade_diagnostics.combo_summaries when you only need the aggregated trade behavior view.

regime_formula_reference.direction_regime: bull if close > EMA200 and EMA200 slope > 0; bear if close < EMA200 and slope < 0; otherwise chop; shifted 1 bar to avoid look-ahead.
regime_formula_reference.direction_confidence: min(abs(close-EMA200)/EMA200, abs(EMA200 slope / close) * 1000) / 0.03, clipped to 0..1 and shifted 1 bar.
regime_formula_reference.vol_state: ATR% rolling mean is compared with rolling quantile thresholds: <=35th percentile contraction, >=65th percentile expansion, otherwise normal; shifted 1 bar.
regime_formula_reference.vol_state_confidence: Distance from contraction/expansion thresholds; normal confidence is highest near the midpoint between thresholds.
regime_formula_reference.trend_strength: ADX <20 choppy, 20-25 weak trend, 25-40 strong trend, >=40 parabolic; shifted 1 bar.
regime_formula_reference.trend_strength_confidence: Distance from the nearest ADX threshold divided by 10, clipped to 0..1.
regime_formula_reference.vol_level: ATR percentile rank over rolling window: <30 low, 30-70 normal, 70-90 high, >=90 extreme; shifted 1 bar.
regime_formula_reference.vol_level_confidence: Distance from the nearest ATR-rank boundary divided by 0.20, clipped to 0..1.
regime_formula_reference.momentum_regime: Volatility-normalized lookback return z-score: weak around zero, positive/negative beyond +/-0.25, strong beyond +/-1.0; shifted 1 bar.
regime_formula_reference.momentum_confidence: Absolute momentum z-score clipped to 0..2 and divided by 2.
regime_formula_reference.correlation_or_risk: Single-symbol runs report unknown with zero confidence; multi-asset panels should add BTC dominance, basket correlation, and alt/BTC ratios.
regime_formula_reference.confidence_note: Direction, trend strength, volatility level, volatility regime, and momentum include confidence; risk/correlation confidence is zero in single-symbol runs.
